caption: The drawing depicts a single, semi-circular object with intricate detailing. The object occupies the center of the image, against a plain, light background. The object has a mesh-like pattern composed of numerous small, repeated motifs in a grid arrangement, covering the entire interior area. The outer curved edge is bordered by a scalloped trim, which is more densely patterned than the interior and consists of repeating rounded segments. The color of the lines in the drawing is dark, contrasting with the light background, and the overall shading is even, with clear definition between the mesh patterns and the border design. There are no additional objects or elements in the drawing.
title: Veil
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
